# Code of Conduct

## The short version

Be decent. This is a small project maintained by one person in their spare
time. Treat everyone in issues, pull requests and discussions with respect,
assume good faith, and keep it constructive.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and welcoming, whatever someone's experience level.
- Give and accept feedback gracefully - critique the code, not the person.
- Stay on topic and keep discussion technical.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory language of any kind.
- Personal or political attacks.
- Publishing others' private information without permission.
- Any conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional setting.

## Scope

This applies to all project spaces - issues, pull requests, discussions and any
other project communication - and to public spaces when representing the
project.

## Enforcement

Reports can be sent privately to **valjdakosta@gmail.com**. All reports will be
reviewed and handled discreetly. The maintainer may remove comments, close
issues, or block accounts that break these rules, at their discretion.

This is a lightweight adaptation of the spirit of the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org). Where a situation
is not covered here, the Covenant's guidance applies.
